concerns.text: T013 has no explicit verification clause. Every other task names a checkable outcome; T013 only describes content. Add e.g. 'Verification: results.md exists, every metric cited matches the corresponding data/processed/*.yaml value, and every referenced figure file exists in data/outputs/'.

T012 requires measuring 'wall-clock time, peak RAM, and disk usage' but names no measurement mechanism (e.g. /usr/bin/time -v, psutil sampling, du). Without a specified tool the measurement is not deterministic across implementers; name the tool or library in the task.

Verification says descriptor values for Sn-3.0Ag-0.5Cu are 'hand-checkable' — vague. Specify the test asserts values within a stated tolerance against independently recomputed values from mendeleev properties, so the unit test is deterministic.

T001 is executable in isolation, but plan.md still mandates the rejected scraping path and the `compositional` dependency while T004 drops it; an implementer reading plan.md + requirements.txt (preserved per Revision behavior) may face a pinned `compositional`/`pdfplumber` dependency conflicting with T004's instruction. Add a task (or extend T004) to update requirements.txt and plan.md to match the re-plan.
